epics.title: Moodle Single Sign-On and Role Synchronization
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiologist accesses the system, I want to authenticate via the Institute Moodle and receive correct role permissions, so that I can seamlessly access appropriate restricted strains without separate credentials.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce login authentication failures from 15% to less than 1%
requirements: R1: Implement OAuth2/OIDC/LTI SSO login flow against the Institute Moodle LMS.
R2: Synchronize Moodle role hierarchy to archive system roles upon login.
R3: Automatically restrict access to strains and reports based on Moodle departments.
R4: Provide an autonomous fallback authentication mechanism if Moodle is down.
R5: User logs in via Moodle, receives synced roles, and accesses restricted data.
R6: In fallback mode, user logs in securely to retain access based on last state.

slices.title: Shared API Contract for Auth Endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing the API contract for this epic, I want to define request/response shapes for SSO and fallback auth, so that backend and frontend can build in parallel.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the SSO endpoint,
When requested,
Then the OpenAPI spec types the token payload.
Given the fallback endpoint,
When defined,
Then the response includes the session fields.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce contract drift defects from 5% to 0%

slices.title: Moodle SSO Integration Backend
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to process Moodle tokens and map them to internal roles, so that secure sessions are established.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid Moodle token,
When processed,
Then the backend creates a session with synced roles like 'Старший научный сотрудник'.
Given Moodle is unreachable,
When a user logs in via fallback,
Then the backend authenticates via cache.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce SSO handshake errors to under 0.1%

slices.title: Data Model for Role Mapping and Fallback Cache
slices.jtbd: When implementing data storage for this epic, I want to store the mapping between Moodle departments and internal roles, so that permissions can be evaluated efficiently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a synced user,
When their Moodle department like 'Кафедра Эпидемиологии' changes,
Then the database updates the internal role mapping.
Given a fallback scenario,
When reading user state,
Then it uses cached credentials.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce role lookup time from 50ms to <10ms

slices.title: SSO and Fallback User Interface
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend for this epic, I want to provide a Moodle login button and a fallback login form, so that users can authenticate seamlessly or recover access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user on the login screen,
When they click 'Log in with Moodle',
Then they are redirected to Moodle.
Given a fallback need,
When using the fallback form,
Then they log in securely.
Given WCAG 2.1 AA requirements,
When navigating with a keyboard,
Then all login controls are fully operable and have 4.5:1 text contrast.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend bundle size and load time
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Improve Time to Interactive on login page to under 1.5s

slices.title: QA E2E and Integration Verification for SSO
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify the complete SSO and fallback workflows, so that no regression occurs in the authentication chain.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a mock Moodle server,
When the E2E suite runs SSO,
Then the user logs in and gets correct roles.
Given the server is down,
When the suite runs fallback,
Then the user logs in using cached credentials.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage of auth flows to 100% without flakiness

epics.title: Measurement: Moodle Integration Effectiveness (GQM)
epics.jtbd: When operating the platform, I want to measure the usage of Moodle SSO and fallback mechanisms. Goal: Prove the system delivers seamless access to epidemiologists. Q1: Are users successfully logging in via Moodle? Q2: How often is the fallback mechanism required?, so that we can demonstrate seamless access.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of successful logins via Moodle SSO to >99%
requirements: R1: The system shall track the ratio of successful Moodle SSO logins to total Moodle SSO login attempts to answer Q1.
R2: The system shall track the daily count of fallback logins to answer Q2.

slices.title: Instrument Auth Telemetry
slices.jtbd: When implementing metrics for this epic, I want to emit structured events for SSO and fallback logins, so that analytics can aggregate the usage data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a successful SSO login,
When the session is created,
Then an auth.success event is emitted.
Given a fallback login,
When it completes,
Then a fallback.used event is emitted.
Given the test environment,
When metrics are verified,
Then assertions prove events are correctly tracked.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of auth events are successfully dispatched to the metric store

epics.title: Regulatory: GDPR Data Subject Rights
epics.jtbd: When a Moodle user requests their data, I want to export or erase their profile and roles, so that the system complies with GDPR data subject rights.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual data export effort from 2 hours to 0 hours via self-service
requirements: R1: Provide a secure method for users to export their synchronized Moodle profile data.
R2: Provide a secure method for users to request erasure of their locally stored data.
R3: Ensure data exports and erasures are delivered within the statutory 30-day deadline.

slices.title: Data Export and Erasure API
slices.jtbd: When implementing compliance API for this epic, I want to extract or delete user records, so that statutory requirements are met programmatically.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user request,
When they invoke the export API,
Then data is returned as JSON.
Given an erasure request,
When invoked,
Then their profile data is irreversibly anonymized.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of PII is removed or anonymized upon erasure execution

slices.title: QA Verification for Data Rights
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify that exports contain all PII and erasures actually remove it, so that we prevent compliance violations.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a seeded user,
When the export is requested,
Then the output contains all known fields.
Given the user is erased,
When looking up their ID,
Then no PII is returned by the system.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage on data compliance endpoints

epics.title: Regulatory: Verified Automated Backups
epics.jtbd: When operating the platform, I want automated backups and verified restore procedures, so that we protect the business against critical data loss.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) from hours to under 15 minutes
requirements: R1: The system shall perform automated daily backups of the database.
R2: A verified restore process must be executed and proven to work.

slices.title: Automated DB Backup and Restore Pipeline
slices.jtbd: When implementing backups for this epic, I want to configure the backup scripts and a test restore environment, so that data loss risks are mitigated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the production database,
When the scheduled job runs,
Then a backup artifact is created.
Given a fresh environment,
When the restore script is executed,
Then the database is fully restored and verified by automated tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% success rate of automated backup and restore tests

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce support tickets for password resets from 20% to 2%
requirements: R1: Provide a self-service recovery path for a locked-out account in the fallback mechanism.

slices.title: Self-Service Fallback Recovery
slices.jtbd: When implementing recovery for this epic, I want to allow users to securely reset their fallback credentials, so that they regain access without manual support.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a locked out user,
When they request recovery,
Then a secure reset link is generated.
Given a valid reset link,
When the user submits a new password,
Then the fallback credentials are updated.
Given the automated test suite,
When the recovery flow runs,
Then it asserts the reset link works.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 99.9% delivery rate for recovery tokens
